focus: Prevent duplicate apartment sash-lock systems from entering formal 4K/reflection evidence and preserve the repository's already-authoritative period-plausible FacadeSashLatchHardware implementation.

decisionCorrection.issueFound: An initial repository pass added a second SashCrescentLocks implementation before the full Editor tree audit surfaced the existing FacadeSashLatchHardware system plus its curve, LOD-continuity, metadata-authority and reflection-binding QA. Keeping both would contradict real manufacture (one lock system per two-panel sash) and increase obvious-repetition, interpenetration, doubled-highlight and temporal-shimmer risk.
decisionCorrection.action: Removed the duplicate implementation, duplicate contract and superseded run record. No duplicate sash-lock files remain in the net diff from startingHead.

existingAuthoritativeEvidence.constructionSummary: 30 one-lock-per-two-panel-window assemblies; sourced 50 mm mounting pitch; continuous swept crescent; separate receiver/fasteners; purpose-built LOD0/1/2/3; legacy EPDM rectangles disabled; material/metadata and reflection state already guarded.
existingAuthoritativeEvidence.externalPeriodBasis: Official LIXIL/Tostem service-part record AAAZC07L documents a metal crescent lock with 50 mm screw pitch for Atmos II from 1996-10 and Thermal II/PG from 1999-02. Reviewed 2026-09-14: https://store.lixil.co.jp/aaazc07l.html

substantiveCommits.message: Specify fail-closed sash hardware uniqueness gate
Enforce single authoritative sash hardware system

implementation.rule: Generated fallback must contain exactly one authoritative FacadeSashLatchHardware root directly under Danchi. Any active renderer-bearing hierarchy outside that root whose name identifies sash-latch/crescent/window-lock hardware is rejected. Authored danchi replacement must not retain generated candidate hardware.
implementation.delegation: Each uniqueness validation first runs the existing SashLatchMetadataAuthority formal scene validation, preserving physical latch construction/material/LOD rules and disabled legacy-handle requirements.
implementation.reasonForNoFrameCache: Reflection and final/temporal culls in the same frame must each observe uniqueness so a mid-frame hierarchy toggle cannot evade the render boundary.

failureInjection: Add active SashCrescentLocks with MeshRenderer while FacadeSashLatchHardware remains active; formal pre-cull must fail.
Add nested CrescentLockExtra or WindowLockExperimental renderer-bearing hierarchy outside the authorized root; formal pre-cull must fail.
Move the authorized root away from direct Danchi parentage; validation must fail.
Enable any legacy HD_WindowHandle_ renderer; delegated physical latch QA must fail.
Delete the authorized root in generated fallback; validation must fail rather than auto-repair during formal cull.
Use authored danchi replacement while generated candidate lock hardware remains; validation must fail.

expectedVisualScoreImpact.geometryConstructionFidelity: small-to-medium: enforces the real construction invariant that one two-panel sash has one lock/receiver mechanism instead of accumulating overlapping alternatives
expectedVisualScoreImpact.periodAccuracySceneAuthenticity: small: preserves the already-sourced late-1990s/circa-2000 latch implementation as the single authority
expectedVisualScoreImpact.temporalLodAliasingStability: small: prevents duplicate independently cross-fading hardware from manufacturing false shimmer or apparent LOD pop
expectedVisualScoreImpact.criticalDefectRisk: medium: directly reduces obvious_repetition, hero_geometry_intersection and missing_construction_material_metadata risk
